Causmag International is seeking a skilled Operator to support our operations located in Young, NSW

The Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of earthmoving plant and equipment to support open cut quarrying operations, material extraction, and material handling activities. 

Duties and responsibilities
-  Operate earthmoving machinery including excavators, loaders, graders, dump trucks, and forklifts in accordance with manufacturer specifications
-  Carry out open cut quarry extraction activities, including excavation and removal of ore using excavators
-  Prepare and maintain site access and haul roads, including levelling and grading roads for dump truck operations
-  Load, haul, and transport ore from pit to screening and processing facilities using dump trucks and loaders
-  Operate loaders to feed mobile screening equipment and manage material stockpiles including moving screened material and fines from screening plant
-  Perform daily pre-start inspections and basic maintenance of earth moving equipment
-  Attend training sessions and safety meetings as and when required as well as carry out hazard identification and workplace inspections.
-  Cleaning up of spillage or other housekeeping requirements as requested or as deemed necessary and carrying out greasing/oiling of earth moving equipment
-  Adherence to Young Mining Company’s Work Health and Safety and Environmental Policies and Procedures
-  Comply with NSW WHS legislation, SWMS, and site safety policies and procedures
-  Maintain operational records, equipment logs, and job documentation and provide routine reporting to supervisor
-  Assist with general site and labouring duties as required and incidental to plant operation

Skills
- Reading and interpreting gauges, indicators, and warning systems
- Basic plant maintenance and fault identification
- Current driver license
- Experience operating earthmoving equipment
- At least 3 years' work experience

Salary range is $65,000 - $85,000 PA commensurate with experience

Fulltime position available

Applications open on 13th July 2026 and closes on 13th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Work with clients to quickly develop clear and detailed briefs across relevant channels. Micro-journey planning:  documenting workshops and creating design artefacts such as storyboards, as-is and future-state journey flows to help clients understand the best solution for the customer.

The UI/UX Designer creates engaging user experiences that delight our clients and their customers. UI/UX Designer responsibilities include gathering requirements, creative design (including some print) and wireframing. To be successful in this role, you should have experience as a UI/UX Designer or a similar role. Salary – Over threshold 

All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.
Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

The Benedict Industries group of companies is a Sydney-based, family-owned and managed Quarrying, Resources and Recycling Company.

In 1978 the Company expanded into mining, acquiring a large sand resource at Chipping Norton (which it extracted until 1999) before embarking on a course of expanding its resource base that continues today. The Company continues to acquire and develop new deposits for extraction throughout the Sydney region and supplies a comprehensive range of Sands, Soils, Sandstone, Decorative Aggregates and Recycled products.

Benedict Industries is looking for MAINTENANCE FITTER to join their team of professionals on a full time and permanent basis.

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Minimum 3yrs experience as a qualified Welder/ Boilermaker/ Fitter.
Ability to work in a high pressured, high paced environment.
Competent and working alone and as part of a team.
Ability to interpret plans & designs.
Awareness of working environment with heavy plant machinery.
Good eye for detail.
Ability to work in a confined area.

Your key accountabilities include, but are not necessarily limited to:
Steel fabrication & welding of new & replacement parts
Scheduled maintenance of Plant, Crushing Plant and Timber Shredder
Scheduling servicing of Plant, Crushing Plant and Timber Shredder.
Emergency repairs of Plant, Crushing Plant and Timber Shredder.
Team input to improve current plant design and assist with re-engineering and installation
Gas Cutting

Quality

Building Associate 
(Contracted as Site Supervisor) – Full-time 
SALARY $88,000 + Superannuation per year

DUTIES
•	Assist in planning, coordinating and monitoring residential construction projects, including new homes, duplexes, granny flats, renovations and extensions.
•	Interpret architectural drawings, specifications, building codes and construction standards to support the accurate execution of building works.
•	Coordinate daily site activities by scheduling subcontractors, trades, materials and equipment to ensure efficient project delivery.
•	Inspect construction work and building materials to ensure compliance with approved plans, quality standards, the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Monitor construction progress, identify and resolve on-site issues, and report project status, timelines and quality outcomes to management.
•	Estimate material quantities, assist in preparing quotations and monitor material usage to support cost-effective project delivery.
•	Liaise with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, certifiers and other stakeholders to coordinate construction activities and resolve site-related matters.
•	Conduct routine site inspections to ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements and maintain a safe working environment.
•	Assist in coordinating project schedules, monitoring construction timelines and supporting the timely completion of projects within budget.
•	Maintain accurate site records, inspection reports, progress documentation and project-related correspondence throughout all stages of construction.

REQUIRED SKILLS
•	Associate Degree, Diploma or higher qualification in Building, Construction Management, Civil Construction, or a closely related field.
•	Minimum 1 years' relevant experience in residential construction, site supervision or building coordination.
•	Sound knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) requirements.
•	Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, construction plans and specifications.
•	Strong organisational, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment.

result.description:
Causmag International is seeking a skilled Plant Operator to oversee and maintain the safe, efficient operation of our chemical production plant located in Young, NSW

The Plant Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of fixed and mobile plant and associated production systems used in the manufacturing of Magnesium Oxide and Magnesium Carbonate.

Key Responsibilities:
-  Operate and monitor processing of Magnesium Oxide and Magnesium Carbonate, including chemical reactions, calcination, milling, and material handling processes
-  Operate and monitor production equipment including crushers, kilns, mills, conveyors, and packaging systems
-  Control and adjust process parameters such as temperature, pressure, flow rates, and material feed rates to maintain chemical reaction conditions and product specifications
-  Monitor process indicators, alarms, and instrumentation to ensure chemical processing systems operate within defined limits
-  Conduct routine inspections of plant and equipment to identify operational issues, leaks, blockages, or abnormal conditions
-  Start up, shut down, and change over plant equipment in accordance with standard operating procedures
-  Record production data, process conditions, and operational observations in logs, reports, and digital systems
-  Perform basic maintenance tasks such as cleaning, lubrication, and minor adjustments, and report faults requiring mechanical or electrical attention
-  Work collaboratively with supervisors, contractors, maintenance personnel, and quality teams to optimise plant performance
-  Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at improving efficiency, safety, and product quality

Key Skills and Attributes:
-  Certificate III or equivalent experience in chemical processing or manufacturing
-  Strong understanding of safety protocols and quality standards
-  Minimum of three years’ experience in this role or similar

Salary range is $65,000 - $85,000 PA commensurate with experience

Fulltime position available

Applications open on 13th July 2026 and closes on 13th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
